intro: Melenas' Head is the severed bounty taken from Lord Melenas, a satyr commander encamped inside Fel Rock. Brought back as absolute proof of his demise, the trophy marks the quiet elimination of a lingering demonic threat on the boughs of Teldrassil.

p: To the night elves guarding Shadowglen and the surrounding reaches of Teldrassil, the mere existence of satyrs upon their new World Tree is a bitter disgrace. Lord Melenas chose to make his lair inside the twisted caverns of Fel Rock, just north of the elven settlements, rallying aggressive grell warriors to his banner. Because the kaldorei prize discretion when handling corruptions so close to their heartlands, this bloody trophy serves as private proof that his scheming has been snuffed out before his influence could spread.
